svg.title: Completion inside the shell: Binit ties plain Readline, then accepts it 1.1–1.3× slower
svg.desc: A slow completion that has to run inside the shell, median: vs ble.sh, 1.2–1.3× faster (Binit 201.6 ms · ble.sh 248.8–260.0 ms, reported); vs plain Readline, about the same, 1.00× (Binit 201.6 ms · Readline 201.5–201.6 ms, reported). Accepting that in-shell completion, median: vs ble.sh, 59–79× faster (Binit 0.41–0.43 ms · ble.sh 24.7–32.8 ms, reported); vs plain Readline, 1.1–1.3× slower (Binit 0.41–0.43 ms · Readline 0.32–0.37 ms, reported).
